meta.name: DCC: Making the Team
meta.description:
Each season, hundreds will audition but only the best-of-the-best have what it takes to earn a spot on this elite team. See who has what it takes to wear the stars on CMT’s Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team on Pluto TV.

24/7: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
Available on: Pluto TV
